definitions.explanation: The standard, default portion size at a restaurant. Particularly used at chain restaurants like beef bowl and ramen shops where multiple sizes are available.

examples.japanese: {並盛|なみも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
{並盛|なみも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧いっぱいになった。
examples.english: I was fully satisfied with the regular serving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{並盛|なみも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なみ}→並：11374_nami⟧にした。
examples.english: I was torn about getting a large, but the regular has a decent amount, so I went with that.

notes:
USAGE:
{並盛|なみも}り is the base/default serving size at restaurants offering multiple portion options. Often abbreviated to just ⟦{並|なみ}→並：11374_nami⟧ when ordering.

ORDERING:
At a ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧ chain, you might say: 「⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦{並|なみ}→並：11374_nami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧」 (beef bowl, regular size).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {並盛|なみも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (regular size, please)
- {並盛|なみも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go with the regular size)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧: large serving
- ⟦{特盛|とくも}り→特盛り：15014_tokumori⟧: extra-large serving
- {小盛|こも}り: small serving (available at some shops)
